notes.text: Large mailboxes: the message list loads in parts while you scroll and opens much faster (45,000 mails: 2.5 s instead of 16 s)
Loading all mails shows its progress in a thin bar above the message list
Setup also asks for 'Alarms & reminders', which push needs for new mail right away; for further accounts too, and once after an update if it is missing
Search: best matches on top, then all hits by date; faster search by sender; word forms for French, Spanish and English
Gmail: setup explains that an app password is needed and opens Google's page for it
At most 100,000 mails per account stay on the phone, the newest ones
In a mail rated dangerous only web links open after a question; other kinds of links stay blocked
Clearer settings pages for vector search and sync limits
Out-of-memory crashes while loading very large mailboxes
A mail being sent waited until a large folder had finished syncing
Opening an older mail of a conversation from the search went back to the previous screen
Reading aloud stops at once and continues with the phone's voice if NovaBird Helper fails
'What's new?' failed when the AI returned an invalid date
